title: Magical Kashmir: Royal Houseboats & Snowy Gulmarg
overview: Experience the enchanting beauty of Kashmir with luxury stays in Srinagar floating houseboats, Gondola rides in Gulmarg, and serene walks through Pahalgam valleys.
highlights: Complimentary Shikara ride on Dal Lake with flower decoration
Luxury Houseboat stay with candle-light dinner
Gondola Phase 1 & Phase 2 tickets included
Private AC Sedan/SUV for all transfers
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in 4-Star handpicked hotels & houseboats
Daily breakfast and dinner (MAP Plan)
Private airport transfers and sightseeing vehicle
1-Hour Dal Lake Shikara Ride
Driver allowances, toll, parking, and GST
exclusions: Pahalgam local union cab for Aru/Betaab valley

itinerary.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara Ride
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Airport where our private representative greets you. Transfer to your luxury Houseboat on Dal Lake. In the evening, enjoy a romantic 1-hour Shikara ride.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Gulmarg Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive to Gulmarg, the Meadow of Flowers. Board the world's second-highest Gondola cable car ride up to Apharwat Peak for breathtaking snow vistas.

itinerary.title: Srinagar Mughal Gardens & Local Heritage Walk
itinerary.description: Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, Chashme Shahi, and Pari Mahal. Explore Pampore saffron fields and local Kashmiri handicraft centers.

itinerary.title: Srinagar to Pahalgam (Valley of Shepherds)
itinerary.description: Drive to Pahalgam along the Lidder River. Visit Betaab Valley (named after the Bollywood movie) and Aru Valley surrounded by pine forests.

itinerary.title: Pahalgam Exploration & Return to Srinagar
itinerary.description: Morning pony ride to Baisaran Meadow (Mini Switzerland). Return to Srinagar in the afternoon for leisure shopping in Lal Chowk.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Enjoy a hearty Kashmiri breakfast before being transferred to Srinagar Airport for your return flight home.

title: Enchanting Kerala: Munnar Hills & Alleppey Backwaters
overview: Immerse your family in lush green tea gardens of Munnar, spice plantations of Thekkady, and an unforgettable overnight luxury houseboat cruise through Alleppey backwaters.
highlights: Overnight stay in private deluxe Houseboat with all meals
Munnar Tea Museum & Mattupetty Dam visit
Kathakali cultural dance performance in Thekkady
Spice Garden Guided Walking Tour
inclusions: 4 Nights Hotel stay + 1 Night Houseboat stay
Daily breakfast at hotels, all meals on Houseboat
Private AC cab for full trip
Spice plantation entry ticket
exclusions: Boating fee at Periyar Wildlife Sanctuary

itinerary.title: Cochin Arrival & Transfer to Munnar
itinerary.description: Pick up from Cochin Airport / Railway Station and drive to Munnar. En route, stop at Cheeyappara and Valara waterfalls.

itinerary.title: Munnar Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.description: Full day tour covering Eravikulam National Park (home to Nilgiri Tahr), Tea Museum, Echo Point, and Mattupetty Dam.

itinerary.title: Munnar to Thekkady (Wild Elephant Country)
itinerary.description: Scenic drive to Thekkady. Check in to resort. Afternoon visit to spice gardens and evening Kathakali & Kalaripayattu show.

itinerary.title: Thekkady to Alleppey Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive to Alleppey backwater jetty. Board your private luxury houseboat by 12:00 PM. Enjoy traditional Kerala meals on board while gliding past palm-fringed canals.

itinerary.title: Alleppey to Kovalam / Cochin Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Disembark houseboat after breakfast. Drive to Cochin for heritage sightseeing at Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, and Mattancherry Palace.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cochin
itinerary.description: Transfer to Cochin Airport / Railway Station with beautiful memories of God's Own Country.

title: Tropical Bali Escape: Ubud Rice Terraces & Seminyak Sunset
overview: Discover Bali's twin souls: the cultural heart of Ubud with jungle swings and monkey forests, paired with Seminyak's luxury beach clubs and sunset cliff temples.
highlights: 2 Nights Private Pool Villa stay in Ubud
Nusa Penida West Island Speedboat Tour & Broken Beach
Uluwatu Sunset Temple & Kecak Dance performance
Balinese Floating Breakfast Experience
inclusions: 6 Nights accommodation in 4/5-Star Resorts & Private Pool Villa
Daily international breakfast + 1 Floating Breakfast
Nusa Penida Day Tour with lunch & snorkeling
Private airport and inter-resort transfers
Indonesian SIM Card with local data
exclusions: Bali Tourist Levy / Visa on Arrival ($35 USD approx)

itinerary.title: Welcome to Bali & Transfer to Ubud Villa
itinerary.description: Warm Balinese welcome at Denpasar Airport (DPS). Private vehicle transfer to your tropical jungle villa in Ubud.

itinerary.title: Ubud Highlights, Jungle Swing & Rice Terraces
itinerary.description: Visit Tegallalang Rice Terraces, take the famous Bali Swing photo, explore Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary, and Tirta Empul Holy Water Temple.

itinerary.title: Mount Batur Sunrise Trek / Jeep Tour & Hot Springs
itinerary.description: Optional early morning 4WD Jeep sunrise tour of Mount Batur crater followed by relaxing dip in Toya Devasya Natural Hot Springs.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Seminyak & Tanah Lot Sunset Temple
itinerary.description: Check out from Ubud and drive to coastal Seminyak. Afternoon visit to sea temple Tanah Lot perched on an offshore rock formation.

itinerary.title: Nusa Penida Island Speedboat Day Trip
itinerary.description: Board speedboat to Nusa Penida. Visit Kelingking T-Rex Beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Beach, and Crystal Bay.

itinerary.title: Uluwatu Cliffside Temple & Jimbaran Seafood Dinner
itinerary.description: Leisure morning. Afternoon visit to Uluwatu Temple perched 70 meters above sea level. Watch the sunset Kecak dance followed by beachside seafood dinner at Jimbaran.

itinerary.title: Souvenir Shopping & Departure
itinerary.description: Visit Krisna Souvenir Center for coffee and woodcarvings before transfer to DPS airport for your homebound flight.

title: Dubai Extravaganza: Desert Safari & Burj Khalifa
overview: Experience the pinnacle of futuristic luxury with ticket entry to Burj Khalifa 124th floor, VIP Red Dune Desert Safari, Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise, and Museum of the Future.
highlights: Burj Khalifa 124th & 125th Floor Observation Deck
Red Dune 4x4 Dune Bashing Safari with BBQ Dinner & Belly Dance
Luxury Marina Dhow Dinner Cruise
Museum of the Future entry ticket
inclusions: 4 Nights stay in 4-Star Centrally Located City Hotel
Daily buffet breakfast
Desert Safari with BBQ dinner & live show
Dubai Marina Dhow Cruise dinner
Airport transfers on shared/private basis
exclusions: Tourism Dirham fee paid directly to hotel

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai & Marina Dhow Cruise Dinner
itinerary.description: Arrival at Dubai International Airport (DXB). Check in to hotel. Evening pickup for a luxury Dhow Cruise dinner along Dubai Marina.

itinerary.title: Half-Day Dubai City Tour & Burj Khalifa
itinerary.description: City tour covering Dubai Creek, Jumeirah Mosque, Burj Al Arab photo stop, and Atlantis The Palm. Evening visit to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa 124th floor.

itinerary.title: Museum of the Future & VIP Desert Safari
itinerary.description: Morning visit to the futuristic Museum of the Future. Afternoon pickup in 4x4 Land Cruisers for thrilling desert dune bashing, camel riding, and henna painting at desert camp.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Day Tour (Grand Mosque & Ferrari World)
itinerary.description: Day trip to Abu Dhabi capital city. Visit the majestic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque and Louvre Abu Dhabi or Ferrari World photo stop.

itinerary.title: Leisure Shopping & Airport Transfer
itinerary.description: Explore Gold Souk & Spice Souk or Mall of the Emirates before transfer to airport.

title: Himachal Thrill: Manali, Solang Valley & Kasol Trek
overview: Designed for thrill-seekers! Experience paragliding in Solang, snow games in Sissu via Atal Tunnel, river rafting in Kullu, and cafe hopping in Kasol.
highlights: Atal Tunnel drive to Sissu waterfall (Lahaul Valley)
River Rafting experience in Beas River, Kullu
Solang Valley Adventure Sports Pass
Kasol Riverside Cafe tour & Chalal Village Walk
inclusions: 4 Nights Stay in Swiss Tents & Mountain View Resort
Daily Breakfast & Dinner
Volvo Bus Tickets Delhi-Manali-Delhi
All internal transfers in cab

itinerary.title: Overnight Volvo Journey from Delhi to Manali
itinerary.description: Board luxury AC Volvo from Delhi (Majnu ka Tilla / Kashmiri Gate) in the evening.

itinerary.title: Manali Arrival & Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Reach Manali in the morning. Check in to resort. Afternoon visit to Hadimba Temple, Vashisht Hot Water Springs, and Mall Road.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley & Atal Tunnel Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive through the engineering marvel Atal Tunnel to Sissu in Lahaul Valley. Afternoon snow activities and paragliding in Solang.

itinerary.title: Kullu Rafting & Transfer to Kasol
itinerary.description: Drive to Kasol. En route, enjoy white water river rafting in Kullu. Check in to riverside camps in Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol Chalal Trek & Return Volvo to Delhi
itinerary.description: Trek to Chalal village along Parvati River. Explore Kasol's famous Israeli cafes before boarding evening Volvo back to Delhi.

title: Thailand Island Paradise: Phuket & Krabi Cruise
overview: Soak in the turquoise wonders of Phi Phi Islands, Railay Beach in Krabi, Patong Beach nightlife, and big Buddha view points in Phuket.
highlights: Phi Phi Island Speedboat tour with buffet lunch & snorkeling
Krabi 4-Island Tour by Longtail Boat
Big Buddha & Phuket Old Town cultural walk
Patong Beach Road Nightlife experience
inclusions: 3 Nights in Phuket + 2 Nights in Krabi 4-Star Beach Resorts
Daily breakfast
Speedboat tour to Phi Phi & Krabi 4-Islands
Inter-city land and ferry transfers

itinerary.title: Arrival in Phuket & Patong Beach Walk
itinerary.description: Land at Phuket International Airport (HKT). Private transfer to Patong hotel. Evening stroll along Patong Beach and Bangla Road.

itinerary.title: Phi Phi Islands Speedboat Tour
itinerary.description: Full day tour to Maya Bay (from the movie The Beach), Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, and Monkey Beach with snorkeling gear included.

itinerary.title: Phuket City Tour & Transfer to Krabi
itinerary.description: Visit Karon Viewpoint, Big Buddha, Wat Chalong, and Phuket Old Town Sino-Portuguese architecture. Ferry transfer to Krabi.

itinerary.title: Krabi 4-Island Speedboat Tour
itinerary.description: Explore Phra Nang Cave Beach, Tup Island, Chicken Island, and Poda Island with emerald waters.

itinerary.title: Leisure & Railay Beach Sunset Walk
itinerary.description: Free day to relax at resort pool or take a longtail boat to scenic Railay Beach for rock climbing and sunset viewing.

itinerary.title: Departure from Phuket / Krabi Airport
itinerary.description: Check out and transfer to airport for departure.
